name: Gator Vet Camp
org: University of Florida, Center for Precollegiate Education and Training
what_you_do: A 1 week camp where you stay on campus. Talented high school students learn about animal medicine and college life. They see rare fields like wildlife and fish care.
who_can_apply: You must live in Florida and go to a Florida high school. You must be a rising 10th to 12th grader. First picks go to first generation, low income, or little vet exposure with some animal experience.
pay_detail: $1,500 program cost plus $25 application fee; need based scholarships
duration: 1 week residential (June 7 to 12 or June 21 to 26 in 2026)
deadline_text: For 2026: applications opened Jan 5 and were due Feb 27, 2026 at 5 PM. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the CPET online portal. Send a transcript and the recommendations or prompts the page lists.
notes: Florida students only. Session 2 dates in the page header say 2025 which looks like a typo for 2026.
